ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity mass covering the central and medial regions. High-intensity mottling and contiguous white patches are localized on the distal edges of the left lobe and as distinct streaks on the distal right lobe. A single, high-intensity focal point is visible at the inferior-medial junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-60 degree aperture; the base of the notch is obscured by low-intensity shadows.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-amplitude serrations along the entire visible boundary. Notable macro-notches and deep jagged indentations are present on the left lobe trailing edge, with finer-scale serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory observed along the trailing edges leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (white) of varying diameters scattered in the lower-central region and on the distal surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned linear high-contrast pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the distal end of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged excavations along the left lobe's trailing edge boundary.
